failureMessage: the precondition is the ONLY decision point — a later-phase skip hides work from the run records and re-litigates a verdict already given

matchLines.what: instructs a conditional skip after the precondition already passed: "{match}"
matchLines.fix: move the run/no-run decision into the task.json precondition, or reword an empty result as an empty outcome; a required input the dispatch lacks is a failure — park the item at task:status:needs-human-action

matchLines.what: code-work announces a discretionary cycle skip: "{match}"
matchLines.fix: let the precondition make that call, or complete the work and report an empty outcome; only a genuine failure may stop a run past the precondition

failureMessage: the merged assertion families accept their pre-merge spelling only until no declaration still uses it, and a spelling the engine stops placing asserts nothing at all

matchLines.what: {match} is the pre-merge spelling of an index-coverage assertion
matchLines.fix: restate it as a named `extractValueSets` entry quantified over by `requireIndexCoverage`'s `eachValueOfSet` — the normalizer that rewrites it today is scheduled for removal (#1643)

failureMessage: a dangling marker cites a rationale nobody recorded, and an orphaned check entry lets the periodic review reaffirm a check that no longer exists

checkSetValues.what: cites rationale entry ({value}), which {packDir}references.md does not carry as RULES-{value}
checkSetValues.fix: add the "- **(RULES-{value})** <reason>" entry — creating {packDir}references.md if the pack has none — or drop the marker; entry numbers are stable identifiers, so a removed entry's number is never reused

checkSetValues.what: cites rationale entry ({value}), which {packDir}references.md does not carry as {skill}-{value}
checkSetValues.fix: add the "- **({skill}-{value})** <reason>" entry — creating {packDir}references.md if the pack has none — or drop the marker; entry numbers are stable identifiers, so a removed entry's number is never reused

checkSetValues.what: carries a rationale entry for check:{value}, which the pack does not carry
checkSetValues.fix: remove the entry with the check it explained, or point it at the check's current id

failureMessage: the doc pointer is the More line a finding prints, and nothing opens it until the check fires — a stale one sits broken until a session follows it into nothing

checkSetValues.what: doc: names {value}, which is not a path in this tree
checkSetValues.fix: point doc: at the file that owns the rule's depth, repo-relative (a canon pack's under packs/<pack>/), or drop the field
